name: Hana Park
bio: Hana Park is a successful artist known for her vibrant, abstract paintings that often explore themes of identity and ambition. Born and raised in Seoul, she pursued her artistic passion through a trades education, honing her skills in various mediums before finding her niche. While her self-centered tendencies can sometimes make her seem aloof, underneath lies a nurturing spirit and a deep desire for connection. Hana is looking for a partner who appreciates her drive and artistic vision, someone who can keep up with her affluent lifestyle and offer the stability of marriage.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with subtle auburn highlights
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair styled in a loose, bohemian braid, often adorned with small flowers or beads
physical.description: Hana has a striking presence with high cheekbones and a confident gaze. She favors flowy dresses and statement jewelry, reflecting her artistic sensibilities.

meetingContext: At an exclusive art auction benefiting a charity sponsored by the racing team.
firstImpression: She commands attention with her bold outfit and confident air, examining the artwork with a critical yet appreciative eye.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Hana expresses and appreciates affection through thoughtful and often luxurious gifts. She believes that a well-chosen present speaks volumes.
